operations.source_name: Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025 statutory guidance
operations.result: The statutory guidance explains scope, responsible persons and legal duties for qualifying premises and events under the 2025 Act.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: A parcel is not classified as a qualifying premises without verified use, capacity and responsibility information.

operations.source_name: Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025 notification requirement
operations.result: The supplementary guidance explains when and how responsible persons notify the Security Industry Authority and which information is required.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Notification requirements depend on verified premises characteristics and do not establish local threat.

operations.result: The Building Safety Regulator provides a postcode search for registered high-rise residential buildings and holds height, floor-count and construction-period information.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: A postcode result requires an exact building/address match; nearby registration cannot be assigned to a parcel.

operations.source_name: Register or manage a high-rise residential building
operations.result: The service supports registration and submission of structure and fire-safety information for qualifying high-rise residential buildings.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Registration workflow metadata is not a building-risk observation.

operations.source_name: Building control approval for higher-risk buildings
operations.result: The guidance covers Building Safety Regulator approval for construction and work on higher-risk buildings, including emergency repairs.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: An approval requirement does not indicate approval status or current safety of a particular building.

operations.source_name: BSR building control approval application data March to May 2026
operations.result: The official publication reports application volumes, determination times, outcomes and statutory-time performance for March to May 2026.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Aggregate regulator performance is not evidence about a named parcel or building.

operations.result: The collection links registration, building assessment certificates, safety cases, resident engagement, mandatory occurrence reporting and complaints guidance.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: A guidance collection is not direct evidence of a building's compliance or risk.

operations.source_name: Managing safety risks in high-rise residential buildings
operations.result: The guide explains reasonable steps for accountable persons to prevent and manage spread-of-fire and structural-failure risks.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Methodology does not establish whether controls are present or effective at a specific building.
